q1.explanationZh: catch (a) cold“着凉；伤风”，a 可有可无：catch a cold 或 catch cold 都对，过去式是 caught。

q2.explanationZh: 表示乘坐某种交通工具用 by + 交通工具，中间不加冠词：by bus、by train、by plane。

q3.explanationZh: do one’s best“尽最大努力”，one’s 在句中要换成 my、our、their 等物主代词。

q4.explanationZh: compete with sb.“与某人竞争”，过去式 competed。

q5.explanationZh: be thankful to sb.“对某人很感激”，感谢的原因用 for：be thankful to sb. for sth.。

q6.explanationZh: calm down“（使）平静下来；冷静”，如 Calm down!

q7.explanationZh: come to an end“结束”，与 finish、be over 意思相同。

q8.explanationZh: change one’s mind“改变主意”，one’s 要换成具体的物主代词，如 change my mind。

q9.explanationZh: by the way“顺便说一下”，常放在句首，后面加逗号。

q10.explanationZh: communicate with sb.“与某人交流”，与 keep in touch with 意思相同。

q11.explanationZh: do harm to sth.“对……有害”，harm 在这里是名词。

q12.explanationZh: come up with“想出；提出（主意、计划）”，后面接 idea、suggestion 等名词。

q13.explanationZh: break down“（机器）出故障；损坏”，相当于 stop working。

q14.explanationZh: complain about sth.“抱怨某事”，about 后接名词或动名词。

q15.explanationZh: both…and…“两者都”，连接两个并列成分，作主语时谓语动词用复数。

q16.explanationZh: come from“来自”，相当于 be from，如 I come from China.

q17.explanationZh: die of“因（疾病等）而死”，如 die of cancer。

q18.explanationZh: check in“（在机场）办理登机手续；（在宾馆）登记入住”。

q19.explanationZh: break into“闯入；破门而入”，过去式是 broke into。

q20.explanationZh: come true“实现”，主语是梦想、愿望等，如 My dream came true.

q21.explanationZh: depend on“依靠，依赖”，与 rely on 意思相同。

q22.explanationZh: consist of“由……组成”，不用被动语态。

q23.explanationZh: big deal“大人物；了不起的事”，如 It’s not a big deal.（没什么大不了的。）

q24.explanationZh: come on 用来催促或鼓励别人：“快点；加油；跟我来”。

q25.explanationZh: care for“照顾；喜欢”，表示“照顾”时与 look after、take care of 意思相同。

q26.explanationZh: “习惯于”= be used to，后接名词或动名词；主语 she 用 is，即 is used to the life in China。

q27.explanationZh: “属于”= belong to，主语 They 是复数，动词用原形 belong to。

q28.explanationZh: “亲自”= by oneself；主语是 I，oneself 要换成 myself，即 by myself。

q29.explanationZh: “照顾，关心”= care for；主语 He 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s：cares for。

q30.explanationZh: “与……交流”= communicate with；介词 by 后面动词要用 -ing 形式：by communicating with。

q31.explanationZh: “由……组成”= consist of；主语 The committee 看作单数，一般现在时用 consists of。

q32.explanationZh: “处理”= deal with；空前有 had，构成过去完成时，要用过去分词 dealt with。

q33.explanationZh: “依靠”= depend on；主语 children 是复数，一般现在时用原形 depend on。

q34.explanationZh: “削减”= cut down；情态动词 must 后用动词原形，cut down on sugar 意为“少吃糖”。

q35.explanationZh: “由于”= because of，后面接名词 the rain；because 后面才接句子。

q36.sampleAnswer: All good things must come to an end.
references: All good things must come to an end.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: 这是一句谚语，字面意思是“所有美好的事物都必然会结束”；“结束”= come to an end，must 后用动词原形。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: 否定祈使句用 Don’t + 动词原形；“伤害……”= do harm to。

q38.sampleAnswer: I am thankful to you for all this help.
references: I am thankful to you for all this help.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “感谢某人”= be thankful to sb.，感谢的原因用 for 引出：for all this help。

q39.sampleAnswer: Would you please tell me how I should deal with it for the time being?
references: Would you please tell me how I should deal with it for the time being?
Would you please tell me how to deal with it for the time being?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “处理”= deal with；“该怎么处理”可以用 how I should deal with it，也可以用“疑问词 + 不定式” how to deal with it；“眼下”= for the time being。

q40.sampleAnswer: Does the new product consist of four main parts inside?
references: Does the new product consist of four main parts inside?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “由……组成”= consist of，一般疑问句主语是单数，用 Does 提问，consist 用原形。

q41.sampleAnswer: Computers are used to help us communicate with others easily.
references: Computers are used to help us communicate with others easily.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “与他人沟通”= communicate with others；help sb. do sth. 中 do 用原形；“轻松地”= easily。

q42.sampleAnswer: All things will come true if you can become hard-working.
references: All things will come true if you can become hard-working.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “实现”= come true；if 引导条件状语从句，主句用将来时 will come true。

q43.sampleAnswer: Lucy thinks young people can learn how to care for others by keeping pets.
references: Lucy thinks young people can learn how to care for others by keeping pets.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “照顾他人”= care for others；“如何照顾”= how to care for；“通过饲养宠物”= by keeping pets，by 后用 -ing 形式。

q44.sampleAnswer: We did our best, but he is still not pleased with us.
references: We did our best, but he is still not pleased with us.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “尽力”= do one’s best，主语 We 所以 one’s 换成 our，过去的事用 did our best；“对……不满意”= not pleased with。

q45.sampleAnswer: A friend is somebody that we can depend on when we are in trouble.
references: A friend is somebody that we can depend on when we are in trouble.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “依靠”= depend on；“可以依靠的人”用定语从句 somebody that we can depend on；“遇到麻烦”= be in trouble。
